breaking.change: New type effect-texture cooks explicit density/heat or shared procedural noise sources into scattering/emission sheets and texture arrays. Particles, effect and vfx files accept one exclusive generate block returning EffectSource {text}, through the existing restricted TS executor. Their normal parsers still own validation and references.
breaking.fix: Declare all effect-texture parameters (og api show file:effect-texture), reference its id as a sheet or #array as a texture array, and return only body declarations from effect generators. See effects section 5 for the checked recipe.

breaking.change: Records include context (look, scene, position and camera). Preview isolates runtime metadata from the project's boot scene; --project-look or --look and --scene apply environment/scene resources to the six shots and cost runs while bounds remain black-stage measurements. Cost-only requires an identical recorded context.
breaking.fix: Regenerate old preview records before --cost-only. Use --project-look --scene <asset> to review in context, --position x,y,z for exact placement (no auto-lift), and --camera px,py,pz,tx,ty,tz,fov for an explicit world-space view.
